comparison.objective: Classify and quarantine a contaminated sample and its transitive contact chain; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Relational reasoning and object sorting versus fine tool manipulation and dynamic mechanical tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Contact-chain samples isolated and others racked versus quantitative carriage and lock-retention criteria. Placement tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: The central tested ability is classification, not mechanical adjustment.
